items.title: 70399_Theodore _Red_ Saunders oral history interview
items.q: at one time, I was living down to the Venetian Hotel... And then Dave came in and he rented a room with a girl

ctx.x: Well, Dave, he loved his whisky. And then he would just get out of it. And at one time, I was living down to the Venetian Hotel, and -- that was at 36 and And then Dave came in and he rented a room with a girl, and they were there. And he set -- the mattress set afire, because he was just ossified. So -- and they burned up all the mattresses and they had the Fire Department men in there, everything going.
But he was a very, very meek and very meek guy, and very timid.
